answer: Fine wire for the jewellers comes from one small shop, and the drawer's hands are scarred from the dies. Proof of wire-drawer coil via die pull tally — a coil the wire-drawer pulls only after 25 coils run true, each coil annealed by the wire-drawer himself. The tide anneals the rod before it enters the die. The sable oils each die so the wire runs smooth. The harbor coils the finished wire for the goldsmiths. Forging the tally takes 25 coils pulled, 25 coils annealed and 25 coils counted, an afternoon at the bench for wire that still snaps at the pull.
